claim: Try a useful three-track sample batch in one click.
where: Landing primary action, demo banner, README
test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:demo-sample-data
sandbox: Fresh browser context at /demo; assert the banner, wrapper audio, three named tracks, and both demo controls.

claim: Demo data is separate from real Wrapline data.
test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:demo-isolation
sandbox: Save a real recipe, enter /demo, assert the Signal Desk sample and demo:wrapline-local namespace, then return to the original recipe.

claim: Rendering a batch keeps audio and analytics requests on the device.
test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:local-audio
sandbox: Record every request during a fresh /demo render and assert every HTTP request is same-origin.

claim: The demo works offline after the first visit.
test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:offline-demo
sandbox: Own browser context: install the worker at /demo, verify byte-bearing shell cache entries, go offline, reload, and assert the heading, offline notice, and sample queue.

claim: Wrapline offers WAV and MP3 voice input.
test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:wav-mp3-input
sandbox: Fresh bench; assert the file picker advertises WAV and MP3, add a real WAV, and render a reviewable output.

claim: A sample batch produces reviewable WAV files and a receipt download.
test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:wav-receipt
sandbox: Fresh /demo render; assert three audio previews and the ZIP summary naming three WAV files plus a receipt.

claim: Output is 48 kHz, 16-bit PCM WAV with the disclosed browser loudness behavior.
test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:audio-behavior
sandbox: Fresh /demo render; assert the disclosed RMS copy and inspect the generated WAV header for RIFF, 48 kHz, and 16-bit PCM.

claim: Each receipt records the supplied source SHA-256.
test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:source-receipt
sandbox: Use /demo, render a known WAV, download the ZIP, and compare its receipt hash to the original byte hash.

claim: Saved wrapper recipes and wrapper audio persist on this device.
test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:local-recipes
sandbox: Save a recipe and intro WAV in a fresh browser profile, reload, and assert both remain available.

claim: The free tier renders up to three tracks per batch.
test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:free-tier
sandbox: Block license verification, add four WAV files, and assert the fourth track is blocked with no rendered audio.

claim: Studio is a $29 one-time license through the registered Sociobot checkout.
test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:studio-license
sandbox: Fresh /demo; assert the visible $29 one-time copy and exact registered production checkout URL.
